question: I need to launch a new analytics dashboard project that includes data processing from our customer CSV files, log analysis from our application logs, and visualization components. Can you help me structure the major milestones and break them down into manageable tasks, making sure we don't have any tasks that are too complex to execute?
answer:
Done! I've set up the **Analytics Dashboard** project with 4 major milestones broken into 28 small, executable tasks — and verified every task is within a safe complexity threshold.

## 📊 Project Structure

**Project:** Analytics Dashboard (ID: `aad80da7-9ec3-4037-9293-af05e8e3208e`)

### Milestone 1 — Customer CSV Ingestion & Processing (60h)
| Task | Complexity | Est. |
|---|---|---|
| Define customer CSV schema & data contract | 2 | 4h |
| Build CSV file intake service | 3 | 8h |
| Implement CSV schema validation & error reporting | 4 | 10h |
| Implement data cleaning & normalization | 4 | 10h |
| Build transformation to analytics-ready dataset | 4 | 12h |
| Load processed customer data into storage | 3 | 8h |
| Write tests for CSV ingestion pipeline | 3 | 8h |

### Milestone 2 — Application Log Analysis Pipeline (52h)
| Task | Complexity | Est. |
|---|---|---|
| Define log format & parsing specification | 2 | 4h |
| Build log collection & ingestion | 3 | 8h |
| Implement log parser to structured events | 4 | 12h |
| Build metrics aggregation (errors, latency, usage) | 4 | 12h |
| Store aggregated log metrics | 3 | 8h |
| Write tests for log analysis pipeline | 3 | 8h |

### Milestone 3 — Visualization Components (64h)
| Task | Complexity | Est. |
|---|---|---|
| Define visualization requirements & design system | 3 | 8h |
| Build chart component library (line/bar/pie) | 4 | 12h |
| Build data table component | 4 | 10h |
| Build filter & date-range controls | 3 | 8h |
| Connect components to data API (mock then real) | 4 | 10h |
| Accessibility & responsive design pass | 3 | 8h |
| Write component tests | 3 | 8h |

### Milestone 4 — Dashboard Integration & Deployment (80h)
| Task | Complexity | Est. |
|---|---|---|
| Design dashboard layout & navigation | 3 | 8h |
| Build API layer / data endpoints | 4 | 12h |
| Integrate pipelines with dashboard | 4 | 12h |
| Implement authentication & access control | 4 | 10h |
| Set up CI/CD & deployment | 4 | 12h |
| Add monitoring & alerting | 3 | 8h |
| Write user & operations documentation | 2 | 6h |
| End-to-end testing & user acceptance | 4 | 12h |

## ✅ Complexity Verification
- **32 tasks analyzed** (4 milestones + 28 subtasks)
- **0 tasks above the complexity threshold** (≥7)
- **Average complexity: 3.7/10** — all tasks are well-scoped and manageable
- Total estimated effort: **~256 hours**

## 🚀 Recommended Starting Point
The top recommendation is **"Define customer CSV schema & data contract"** (priority 9, complexity 2, 4h) — a low-risk foundation task that unblocks the rest of the CSV pipeline. The log parsing spec is a good parallel starter since the two data tracks are independent.

**Suggested execution order:** Start both data tracks in parallel (schema + log spec), then build intake/collection → validation/parsing → transformation/aggregation → storage. Visualization work can begin once the design system is defined, and integration/deployment follows once both pipelines and components are ready.
